request.input:
Blood request c26 from a hospital.
Hospital note: "send 3 units for theatre"
Parsed by code from the note: blood group NOT STATED, units 3.

questions.instructions: How urgent is the clinical need behind this blood request, judged from the hospital's note?

levels.description: Stock replenishment or standing order; no patient currently waiting.
levels.label: routine restock

levels.description: A scheduled procedure or transfusion that can wait a day or more.
levels.label: planned / elective

levels.description: A patient needs blood within hours but is not in immediate danger.
levels.label: urgent

levels.description: Active haemorrhage, massive transfusion protocol, or a patient who may die without blood now.
levels.label: massive transfusion or life-threatening

questions.name: urgency

questions.instructions: The request cannot be acted on safely because the blood group requested, the number of units, or what the blood is for is missing or unclear. A request that states all three clearly is not ambiguous, even if it asks for a group the patients may not need.
questions.name: note_ambiguous
